venture.name: Smart Sort
venture.concept: A proposed basket that automatically separates laundry.
venture.target_customers: Busy households and apartment residents; college students are also mentioned in the concept.
venture.value_proposition: Proposed reduction in sorting time and mixing errors through automatic separation.
venture.geographic_market: United States first for research; international expansion is a future possibility.
venture.features: Proposed sensors/cameras identify color and material; moving flap directs items to whites, colors, delicates, heavy items or unwashables. Performance requires prototype testing.

representative_comparison.basis: One listed price per manual sorting product; before tax, shipping and conditional discounts.

preliminary_pricing_recommendation.basis: Exploratory testing range, above most manual sorters and near or above the premium $150 Tota; not a validated market price.

limitations: Manual products do not demonstrate willingness to pay for automation.
Prototype, accuracy, costs, repair needs and demand are unknown.
Prices and availability can change by location and over time; tax and delivery excluded.
The reviewed set is selective, not a complete market census.
